title: osmFISH Protocol for Mouse Brain Tissue
author: Simone Codeluppi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.psednbe
materials: Inject Slow Fade Diamond imaging buffer (Thermo). Do not use hardening mounting media in the flow cell. You can use hardening mountine media if the coverslips will be mounted on a slide before imaging.

steps.title: Tissue Collection and Freezing
steps.instruction: Prepare the mouse brain for sectioning.

substeps.instruction: Transcardially perfuse a mouse with cold oxygenated artificial spinal fluid solution.
Quickly dissect the brain on a cold surface.
Place the brain in a cryomold and fill with Tissue-Tek O.C.T. (Sakura).
Snap freeze the sample by lowering the cryomold into a slush of isopentane and dry ice (ensure slush is prepared before dissection and bubbling has stopped).
Store the sample at -80°C.

steps.title: Coverslip Preparation and Functionalization
steps.instruction: Clean and silanize #1.5 coverslips to prepare them for tissue mounting.

substeps.instruction: Rinse coverslips in distilled water twice for 20 minutes each.
Incubate coverslips in concentrated nitric acid for 24 hours.
Rinse coverslips in water 4 times for 1 hour each.
Fill the beaker with distilled water and sterilize coverslips by autoclaving.
Wash coverslips once with 95% ethanol and store in 95% ethanol.
Place coverslips in a rack and air dry to remove ethanol.
Prepare 2% (v/v) (3-Aminopropyl)triethoxysilane (APS, Sigma) in acetone in a staining jar using fresh APS stored in a dry environment.
Dip the rack of coverslips in the APS solution for 1 minute, followed by a 1 minute dip in RNAse free water.
Air dry the coverslips and store in a desiccated environment.

steps.title: Tissue Sectioning and Fixation
steps.instruction: Cut tissue sections and fix them onto the functionalized coverslips.

substeps.instruction: Cryocut 10µm thick sections of fresh frozen tissue and mount onto functionalized coverslips. To remove electrostatic charge, clean one side of the coverslip with a Kimwipe wetted with ethanol.
Create a fixing chamber by cutting a hole in a piece of Parafilm and placing it in a petri dish to act as a spacer.
Place a drop of 4% PFA (preferably prepared from powder for lower background) in the petri dish inside the Parafilm hole.
Immediately after capture, fix the section face down on the PFA drop for 10 minutes.
Transfer the glass to a clean petri dish and rinse twice with PBS.
Remove excess PBS and dry the slide with a tissue, avoiding contact with the tissue section.
Dehydrate the slide in >1ml of isopropanol for 3 minutes, then air dry.
Store the slide at -80°C until use.

steps.title: Tissue Clearing
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample in a flow cell (e.g., Microliquid) and clear the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Assemble the sample in the flow cell.
Rehydrate the tissue for 5 minutes with 2X SSC buffer.

Clear the tissue by incubating with 4% SDS in 200mM boric-acid (pH 8.5) 4 times for 5 minutes each. Use a wash volume double that of the flow cell (e.g., 1ml for a 500ul cell) and replace the liquid at least once.
Wash the section with 2X SSC 5 times.
Wash the tissue twice with Tris EDTA buffer (pH 8).

steps.title: Hybridization Round
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of probe hybridization.

substeps.instruction: Perform a heat shock by placing the sample at 70°C for 10 minutes.

Pre-hybridize: Incubate tissue for 5 minutes at room temperature with hybridization mix without probes (2X SSC, 10% w/v Dextran sulfate, 10% v/v Formamide, 1 mg/ml E. coli tRNA, 2mM Ribonucleoside vanadyl complexes (RVC), 0.2 ml/ml BSA).

Hybridize: Incubate tissue for 4 hours at 38.5°C with hybridization mix containing probes (same mix as above plus 250nM Probes per target, Sellaris/LGC Biosearch technologies; ~48 probes/target). Note: Optimize temperature for your specific incubator to balance background and staining.
Perform stringency washes: Wash 4 times for 15 minutes each with 20% formamide in 2X SSC at 38.5°C. Add nuclear staining (e.g., Hoechst, Dapi) if needed.
Wash with 2X SSC.
Image the region of interest, saving the field of views for future rounds.

steps.title: Probe Stripping
steps.instruction: Remove probes to prepare for the next round of hybridization.

substeps.instruction: Wash 5 times with 2X SSC to remove mounting media.
Strip probes by washing 3 times for 10 minutes each with 65% formamide in 2X SSC at 30°C.
Optional: Verify signal stripping via imaging.

steps.title: Repeat Hybridization Rounds
steps.instruction: Repeat the hybridization and stripping process for all remaining targets.

substeps.instruction: Incubate tissue with hybridization mix without probes for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate tissue with hybridization mix containing 250nM probes per target for 4 hours at 38.5°C.
Wash 5 times with 2X SSC.
Perform stringency washes: Wash 4 times for 15 minutes each with 20% formamide in 2X SSC at 38.5°C (add nuclear stain if needed).
Wash with 2X SSC.
Perform imaging of the region of interest.
Repeat the stripping and hybridization cycle until all targets have been labeled.
